summary: SESSION_EXECUTION_AUTHORIZATION: continue repairs, tests and protected merges. Complete PLF-091 / GitHub196 with persisted incremental dirty selection and repository-scoped provider cooldown.

delivery.outcome: Explicit incremental outbound synchronization persists changed/new revisions, skips acknowledged unchanged records before backend initialization, drains only the requested scope in bounded cycles and honors provider cooldown across that repository after restart. Protected exact-head merge and installed runtime verification.
nonGoals: No global account-wide provider quota service
No fleet activation or background daemon
No inbound incremental reconciliation or legacy v1 migration
No dependencies or publication policy changes

architecture.decision: Use the existing digest-bound receipt log and revision-fenced RetryQueue as durable acknowledgement/dirty state. Read current rather than historical acknowledgement and current local tickets before enqueue. Add an additive repository pause table and enforce it before claim; rate-limit failures pause the repository and stop the cycle without sleeping. Incremental CLI initializes the provider only if there is an eligible exact-ticket job. Preserve current scoping, routing, dry-run and failure signals.

dataChanges.description: Add repository retry deadline table to the existing ignored GitHub retry journal; retain existing job schema and old journals.

architecture.rollback: Revert protected merge; preserve receipts and retry jobs.

commands: python3 -m pytest tests/test_sync_incremental.py tests/test_sync_incremental_cli.py tests/test_sync_retry.py tests/test_sync_completion.py tests/test_sync_receipts.py tests/test_sync_rate_limit_diagnostics.py -q
validation.evidence: Genuine before-fix regressions for unchanged selection, scope isolation, concurrent edits/reverts, retry pause across jobs/restart and narrow/wide CLI dry-run. Real existing-issue canary, full suite, Ruff, exact head/base OneDev, independent protected merge and installed readback.
